aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Set five years after The Rise of Skywalker, a skilled space pilot embarks on a dangerous galactic adventure to protect a young, Force-sensitive boy from relentless warlords and mercenaries.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Taking place five years after the fall of the First Order, Star Wars: Starfighter explores a galaxy rebuilding itself amid fractured powers. When a young Force-sensitive boy's mother is killed, he is entrusted with a lightsaber and sent to find his unknown uncle. A skilled starship pilot steps up to shelter and guide the young boy, leading them on a perilous journey across space. Together, they must evade a powerful military general and a formidable lightsaber-wielding mercenary hunting the child.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Set approximately five years after the events of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker, Star Wars: Starfighter delves into the fragile state of the galaxy following the defeat of the Sith Eternal. The story begins with a young, Force-sensitive boy whose mother is slain by dark forces, leaving him with her lightsaber and instructions to seek out an uncle he has never met. His path crosses with a rogue, highly skilled space pilot who unexpectedly becomes his guardian and navigator through dangerous territories. As they journey across distant star systems, they are relentlessly pursued by a cold, ambitious military commander aiming to consolidate power in the lawless post-war era. Adding to the danger is a deadly Force-sensitive mercenary armed with a lightsaber, tasked with tracking the boy down at all costs. Along their journey, the unlikely duo encounters unique allies and confronts remnants of the galaxy's turbulent past. The pilot must learn to trust the Force and embrace a higher calling beyond survival, while the boy discovers the true extent of his heritage. Ultimately, their bond and resilience are put to the test in a high-stakes struggle that will shape the next era of the galaxy.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Set roughly five years after the battle of Exegol and the climax of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker, Star Wars: Starfighter introduces an original, standalone chapter in the expanding galaxy. In a universe striving to recover from decades of conflict, new threats emerge from the power vacuums left behind by the Empire and the First Order. The narrative follows a young boy discovering his deep connection to the Force after a sudden tragedy upends his life. Guided only by a legacy weapon and a mission to find long-lost family, he aligns with an experienced starship pilot navigating the galaxy's perilous fringes. Together, they face off against ruthless military remnants and mercenary threats, blending high-octane space combat with a deeply personal story of protection, destiny, and hope.

story_structure.climax: A desperate, large-scale dogfight erupts against a formidable hostile fleet, forcing the protagonist to execute daring maneuvers and make a decisive personal sacrifice in the cockpit.
story_structure.conflict: Emerging rogue factions and opportunistic warlords threaten the fragile peace of the galaxy, thrusting the protagonist into a high-stakes mission where aerial supremacy and pilot skill are paramount.
story_structure.resolution: With the threat neutralized, the galaxy takes another step toward lasting peace, and the pilot secures a newfound sense of purpose among the stars.
story_structure.introduction: Set five years after the events of The Rise of Skywalker, the galaxy enters a delicate era of rebuilding. A veteran pilot navigating this uncertain post-war landscape is introduced, attempting to forge a new path away from conflict.
story_structure.risingAction: The protagonist forms an unlikely crew, embarks on dangerous reconnaissance and escort missions across unfamiliar sectors, and uncovers a widespread conspiracy that jeopardizes galactic stability.

faq.answer: Yes, it is a standalone live-action feature film set within the broader Star Wars universe, produced by Lucasfilm and distributed by Walt Disney Studios Motion Pictures.
faq.question: Is Star Wars: Starfighter part of an existing franchise?

faq.answer: The film's primary genre is sci-fi/space opera, blending action, adventure, and space combat drama.
faq.question: What is the dominant genre of Star Wars: Starfighter?

faq.answer: The movie is scheduled for theatrical release in the United States on May 28, 2027.
faq.question: When is Star Wars: Starfighter scheduled to be released?

faq.answer: The film is directed by Shawn Levy, with a screenplay written by Jonathan Tropper.
faq.question: Who is directing Star Wars: Starfighter?

faq.answer: The film stars Ryan Gosling alongside Flynn Gray, Mia Goth, Matt Smith, Aaron Pierre, Simon Bird, Jamael Westman, Daniel Ings, and Amy Adams.
faq.question: Who stars in Star Wars: Starfighter?

faq.answer: No, while it takes place approximately five years after the events of Star Wars: Episode IX - The Rise of Skywalker, it is a standalone story with new main characters rather than Episode X.
faq.question: Is Star Wars: Starfighter a direct sequel to Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker?

faq.answer: It is set about five years after Episode IX (The Rise of Skywalker), placing it further along the galactic timeline than any prior live-action Star Wars release.
faq.question: Where does Star Wars: Starfighter fit in the Star Wars timeline?

faq.answer: No, director Shawn Levy has emphasized that the film focuses on brand-new characters, unexplored regions, and original storylines rather than legacy Skywalkers.
faq.question: Does Star Wars: Starfighter focus on legacy characters?

faq.answer: While Star Wars theatrical films traditionally do not include mid- or post-credit scenes, official details regarding end-credit sequences will be confirmed closer to its release.
faq.question: Is there a post-credit scene in Star Wars: Starfighter?

faq.answer: No, although it shares the title of the 2001 video game, the film is an original story and not a direct adaptation of the game.
faq.question: Is Star Wars: Starfighter based on the 2001 video game of the same name?
